sheets.title: JESB LOT 7 - EXTERIOR MODEL R02
sheets.subtitle: SketchUp model rebuilt from the architect's floor plan and elevation DWGs (issue 16.10.2026)
notes: Design: Purohit Architects, Inc. (202601.LOT 7), Revision 1. Modelled as drawn; exterior only, no interior.
Plan geometry from the floor plan DWGs xflr0/1/2 (16.10.2026); heights, roof heights and window heads/sills from the elevation DWG xelev; roof layout from A-220.
Datum: z = 0 at the top of the main floor (839.20'). Front faces west.

Materials per the ACC Material Package, Lot 7: roof Mission Brown, brick Magnolia, siding Cobble Stone, trims / soffit / fascia / windows white, front and garage doors brown (cottage style with glass on top).
Grade from the elevation grade lines only (no site plan). Driveway is an assumption.
R02: lower front gable over the garage bump with eave returns, decorative panels; garage gable eaves per the front elevation.

Open items: see JESB_Lot7_Model_R02_Change_Log.md (garage front moved 9.36 in. in the new first floor plan but not on the elevations; portico upper window 60 in. in plan vs 86 in. on the elevation; and others).
